overview: Building an IDE copilot and autonomous code agents that can call tools (test runners, linters, build systems) inside rented sandboxes. Principal need: secure function calling with structured outputs, fast streaming to editors, and per-workspace model pinning. POC showing end-to-end flow from suggestion -> run tests in sandbox -> return structured test results/logs.
requirements_summary: Structured function/tool calling: start_test_suite(run_id, params)->returns run_id and async status callbacks
Sandboxing: strongly isolated ephemeral sandboxes (Wasm/Firecracker) with allow-listed network egress
Streaming: sub-100ms median token latency to VSCode websocket client for typing feel
Model/version pinning: per-repo pinned models with stable fallback chain
Audit and telemetry: immutable per-call audit logs exportable to SIEM, with log retention controls
Artifacts: build/test artifacts must be stored in customer VPC S3 compatible store
KMS: customer-managed keys for any persisted outputs and model cache encryption
